shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Li Chenggang, China’s international trade negotiator and vice minister, met with a U.S.-China Business Council board delegation on the morning of September 2, and the two sides exchanged views on China-U.S. economic and trade relations and other issues.

title: Li Chenggang Meets U.S.-China Business Council Board Delegation
